prog.description: The local program to run behind the TLS wrapper.

verbose.description: Verbosity flag: empty for default (-Q), 'q' for quiet (-q), 'v' for verbose (-v), 'vv' for debug (-vv), 'vvv' for trace (-vvv).

cert_files.description: List of file paths containing PEM certificates and keys (-f). SNI-based lookup uses cert_dirs instead or in addition.

cert_dirs.description: List of directories containing SNI-based certificate files (-d). If null, no SNI-based directory lookup is used.

client_auth_anchor.description: Path to the CA trust anchor file for client certificate authentication (-a). If null, client auth is disabled.

extract_user_from_cert.description: ASN.1 object name to extract user from client cert (-U). Either 'commonName' or 'emailAddress'. If null, no extraction.

ciphers.description: List of symmetric encryption ciphers to enable (-c), in preference order.

ephemeral_algorithms.description: List of ephemeral key exchange algorithms to enable (-e).

min_tls_version.description: Minimum TLS version to allow (-m). One of tls10, tls11, tls12, tls13.

max_tls_version.description: Maximum TLS version to allow (-M). One of tls10, tls11, tls12, tls13.

run_user.description: Username to run the target program under (-u). If null, runs as the invoking user.

jail_user.description: Username to run network/key processes under inside the jail (-j). If null, uses random uid/gid.

enforce_server_preferences.description: If true, enforces TLS server cipher preference (-s). If false, uses client preference (-S).

don_t_enforce_server_preferences.description: Explicitly set to true to disable server preference enforcement (-S). Conflicts with enforce_server_preferences in practice.

enable_delayed_encryption.description: Enable delayed encryption for STARTTLS-like protocols (-n). Requires child process to write to fd 5.

don_t_disable_delayed_encryption.description: Explicitly set to false to disable delayed encryption (-N). Conflicts with enable_delayed_encryption in practice.

proxy_protocol_version.description: Enable proxy-protocol version string (-p). e.g., '1', '2'. If null, proxy protocol is disabled.
